errors.text: The proposed low-shear-strength, low-friction amorphous layer is internally inconsistent with the predicted spike in friction coefficient unless an additional mechanism for increased tangential force is supplied.

The hypothesis treats a significant drop in HCP atom count as the diagnostic signature of amorphization, whereas the target behavior reports increasing HCP atom fraction with temperature alongside increasing disorder.
Stacking-fault annihilation followed by immediate amorphization is asserted as a specific causal sequence without supporting evidence from the stated simulations.
